docket_entries.description: ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,930.00 FILED BY AMIROUCHEN, SAMY AS TO DEFENDANT JUSTMAN, LORI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-22-2021 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $40) SERVED OCT-28-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT JUSTMAN, LORI
REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM FILED BY PLAINTIFF AMIROUCHEN, SAMY
DECLARATION RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM FILED BY PLAINTIFF AMIROUCHEN, SAMY
ORDER RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM **GRANTED**

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-22-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO DEC-20-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SAMY AMIROUCHEN IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT LORI JUSTMAN IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $760.00 (COSTS INCLUDED)TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE DEC-20-2021 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT OF NOV-22-2021. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. VISITING JUDGE: RONALD QUIDACHAY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
